description: Bike Counter Locations (Eco Counter) is a dataset listed in City of Edmonton open data portal (data.edmonton.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Edmonton. This dataset lists the bicycle only or bicycle and pedestrian counter locations in the city. There are a number of locations along bike lanes in addition to some key cyclist/pedestrian traffic areas. Coverage: Edmonton. The portal files it under the category Monitoring and Data Collection. Its tags are cyclist counters, bicycle counters, pedestrian counters, bike. The table has 12 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Edmonton. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-edmonton-ca-portal.
